test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: An article is sold at a profit of 25%. If both the cost price and the selling price of the article are increased by Rs. 200, then the profit percentage is 20%. What is the original cost price of the article?
solution:
Given:

The article is sold at a profit of 25%.

If both the cost price and the selling price of the article are increased by Rs. 200, then the profit percentage is 20%.

Concept used:

Selling Price = Cost Price + Cost Price × Profit%

Calculation:

Let the original cost price of the article be Rs. P.

Hence, selling price = P + P × 25% = Rs. 1.25P

According to the question,

(P + 200) + (P + 200) × 20% = (1.25P + 200)

⇒ P + 200 + 0.2P + 40 = 1.25P + 200

⇒ 1.2P + 240 = 1.25P + 200

⇒ P = 800

**∴ The original price of the article is Rs. 800.**
